entry.title: CSRC Relays State Council Executive Meeting Spirit and Arranges Implementation Measures
entry.summary: 中国证监会传达学习贯彻国务院常务会议精神 中国证监会 · Nov 27, 2026 · MeetingOn November 27, the China Securities Regulatory Commission held an expanded Party committee meeting to convey the spirit of a State Council executive meeting and arrange implementation measures. The meeting stressed implementing existing policies and studying new ones, covering market stabilization mechanisms, expanding medium- to long-term investors, guarding against imported risks, deepening capital market reform, and strengthening full-chain supervision.

entry.title: CSRC Penalizes Two Cases of Fabricating and Spreading Misleading Securities Market Information
entry.summary: 中国证监会严肃查处两起编造传播证券市场误导性信息案件 中国证监会 · Nov 27, 2026 · EnforcementThe China Securities Regulatory Commission has penalized Mr. An and Mr. Qiao for fabricating and spreading misleading securities market information, ordering confiscation of illegal gains and fines. They posted misleading information about listed companies China Public Education and Gongjin Co. on online platforms, which spread widely and caused abnormal stock price fluctuations. The CSRC said it has zero tolerance for rumor-mongering and urged investors to verify information carefully.

entry.title: CSRC approves registration of corrugated base paper futures and options
entry.summary: 中国证监会同意瓦楞原纸期货和期权注册 中国证监会 · Nov 27, 2026 · LicensingThe China Securities Regulatory Commission recently approved the Shanghai Futures Exchange's registration of corrugated base paper futures and options. The CSRC will direct the exchange to complete preparations to ensure both products launch smoothly and operate steadily.

entry.title: State Council Meeting Discusses Promoting Steady, Healthy Capital Market Development and Reviews Draft Regulation on Production Safety Accident Hazard Inspection
entry.summary: 国务院常务会议：促进资本市场平稳健康发展 中国证监会 · Nov 27, 2026 · MeetingOn November 27, 2026, the State Council executive meeting studied deepening comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing. It called for improving market stabilization mechanisms, implementing existing policies and planning new ones, encouraging listed companies to increase dividends and buybacks, and strengthening the stabilizing role of state-backed funds and Central Huijin. It also supports long-term funds such as insurance, enterprise annuities and social security funds entering the market, and calls for full-chain supervision that punishes financial fraud and illegal share reductions.

entry.title: CSRC Chairman Meets Indian Ambassador to China
entry.summary: 吴清主席会见印度驻华大使魏嘉盟 中国证监会 · Nov 23, 2026 · MeetingOn November 23, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met Indian Ambassador to China Vikram Kumar Doraiswami in Beijing. The two sides exchanged views on global financial market conditions, capital market reform and development in China and India, and deepening practical cooperation.

entry.title: CSRC and Police Publish Four Cases of Fabricated Capital Market Rumor Penalties
entry.summary: 证券监管部门联合公安机关依法处罚编造传播资本市场虚假信息行为 公布4起典型案例 中国证监会 · Nov 20, 2026 · EnforcementSecurities regulators and public security authorities jointly published four typical cases of fabricating and spreading false capital market information. The cases cover a fake tax policy rumor, AI-generated false claims about IPO suspensions, a forged regulatory warning letter, and a fabricated layoff report at a listed company. The responsible individuals have been administratively penalized, and the agencies pledged continued enforcement against such online rumors.

entry.title: CSRC spokesperson answers press question: denies report that fund firms must disclose AI exposure for all products
entry.summary: 中国证监会新闻发言人答记者问 中国证监会 · Nov 18, 2026 · SpeechA spokesperson for the China Securities Regulatory Commission responded to online claims that regulators require fund companies to report AI exposure for all their products, stating the information is untrue. The spokesperson said public fund investments follow the Securities Investment Fund Law and fund contracts, with investment targets and proportions set independently by fund managers. The CSRC said it has not made such a data reporting request to fund managers.

entry.title: CSRC Vice Chair Meets IOSCO Secretary General
entry.summary: 中国证监会陈华平副主席与国际证监会组织秘书长举行会谈 中国证监会 · Nov 17, 2026On November 10, 2026, CSRC Vice Chair Chen Huaping met IOSCO Secretary General Rodrigo Buenaventura while attending an IOSCO Board meeting. They exchanged views on deepening cooperation and strengthening global financial governance. They also signed an agreement for the CSRC to second staff to the IOSCO Secretariat.

entry.title: CSRC International Advisory Committee holds 23rd meeting in Shanghai on capital market development
entry.summary: 中国证监会在沪召开国际顾问委员会第23次会议 中国证监会 · Nov 16, 2026 · MeetingOn November 13, 2026, the 23rd meeting of the CSRC International Advisory Committee was held in Shanghai under the theme "China's Capital Market Towards 2030." Members discussed building an inclusive market ecosystem, enhancing resilience, and improving global governance. They offered advice on expanding long-term funds, linking private funds with public markets, smarter supervision, and institutional opening-up.

entry.title: Speech by CSRC Chairman Wu Qing at the Opening of the First China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference
entry.summary: 吴清主席在首届中国资本市场学术年会开幕式上的致辞 中国证监会 · Nov 14, 2026 · SpeechChina Securities Regulatory Commission Chairman Wu Qing gave this speech at the opening of the first China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference. He reviews the development of China's capital market over 36 years, including legal frameworks, the multi-tiered market system, financing structure and opening-up. The speech also discusses opportunities and challenges posed by global governance shifts, technological revolution and Chinese-style modernization, and proposes several research topics and three suggestions for strengthening capital market research.

entry.title: National Bureau of Statistics Sends 2026 Routine Statistical Inspection Feedback to China Securities Regulatory Commission
entry.summary: 国家统计局2026年常规统计督察第9统计督察组向中国证监会反馈统计督察意见 中国证监会 · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementOn November 11, the National Bureau of Statistics gave the China Securities Regulatory Commission feedback from its 2026 routine statistical inspection. The inspection found shortcomings in implementing statistical policy decisions, fulfilling statutory statistical duties, data quality control, and grassroots statistical infrastructure. The CSRC must rectify these issues, report progress to the bureau within three months, and make it public as required. The CSRC said it accepts the feedback in full and will rectify firmly.

entry.title: CSRC Official Answers Reporters' Questions on Investor Redress for Oriental Tongzheng and Qingyue Technology
entry.summary: 中国证监会有关部门负责人答记者问 中国证监会 · Nov 11, 2026 · SpeechA CSRC official responded to the Beijing Financial Court's application of special representative proceedings to the Oriental Tongzheng Securities false statement case, expressing support for the China Securities Investor Services Center representing investors. On the Qingyue Technology false statement case, the official supported voluntary advance compensation by related parties and said the CSRC is seeking public comment on draft guidelines on advance compensation in the securities market.

entry.title: CSRC and Oman's Financial Services Regulatory Authority sign securities and futures cooperation memorandum
entry.summary: 中国证监会与阿曼金融服务管理局签署《证券期货监管合作谅解备忘录》 中国证监会 · Nov 5, 2026On November 2, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing and Omani Foreign Minister Badr signed a memorandum of understanding on securities and futures regulatory cooperation in Beijing. The memorandum aims to strengthen regulatory exchange and cooperation in the securities and futures sector and promote the healthy development of both countries' capital markets.

entry.title: Officials of the China Securities Regulatory Commission answer reporters' questions on recent work to stabilize markets and expectations
entry.summary: 中国证监会有关部门负责人就近期稳市场稳预期相关工作答记者问 中国证监会 · Nov 2, 2026 · SpeechCSRC officials describe how two structural monetary policy tools, the swap facility for securities, fund and insurance firms and the special relending for share buybacks and increases, have been operating. They outline plans to expand participating institutions, refine listed companies' buyback rules, advance active ETF issuance, and adjust margin financing risk-control indicators.

entry.title: CSRC Party Committee Relays Spirit of Fifth Plenary Session of 20th CPC Central Committee
entry.summary: 中国证监会党委传达贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神 中国证监会 · Oct 30, 2026 · MeetingOn October 30, 2026, the CSRC Party Committee held an expanded meeting to relay Xi Jinping's important speech and the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, and to arrange implementation measures. The meeting called for stricter comprehensive Party discipline in political and ideological work, leadership building, accountability, anti-corruption, and regulatory team building.

entry.title: CSRC Issues Rules on Administrative Penalties for Illegal Securities Transfer Cases
entry.summary: 中国证监会发布《违规转让证券案件行政处罚实施规则》 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 · RuleThe China Securities Regulatory Commission issued the Implementing Rules on Administrative Penalties for Illegal Securities Transfer Cases on October 19, 2026, effective December 1, 2026. The eighteen-article rules define illegal securities transfers, sort them into four categories, and set different discretionary penalty criteria for each category, along with provisions on penalty adjustments and market bans.](Non)

entry.title: CSRC official answers reporters' questions on rules for administrative penalties in illegal securities transfer cases
entry.summary: 中国证监会有关部门负责人就《违规转让证券案件行政处罚实施规则》答记者问 中国证监会 · Oct 19, 2026 · GuidanceA responsible official of the China Securities Regulatory Commission answered reporters' questions on the Implementing Rules for Administrative Penalties in Illegal Securities Transfer Cases, issued on October 19, 2026. The eighteen-article rules classify illegal securities transfers into four categories. They set lenient, general and severe penalty tiers based on the violation ratio and amount, and specify related penalty circumstances. entry.title: Former Hubei CSRC bureau party chief Wang Guangyou expelled from the Party
entry.summary: 湖北证监局原党委书记、局长王广幼被开除党籍 中国证监会 · Sep 28, 2026 · EnforcementThe CCDI-led discipline inspection team stationed at the CSRC and the Hubei Supervisory Commission investigated former Hubei CSRC bureau party secretary and director Wang Guangyou for serious violations. Findings include receiving gifts and cash, improperly borrowing large sums, trading stocks, interfering in securities enforcement, and accepting large amounts of illicit property, with suspected bribery. The CSRC Party committee expelled him from the Party, confiscated illegal gains, and referred the suspected criminal matter to prosecutors for review.
